contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [VICT DD NN AVG ET CAES]

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Magnentius (350-353), Reece period 18, VICT DD NN AVG ET CAES issue of 351-353. Obverse description: Bust draped right, legend trimmed off. Reverse description: Two Victories with column between them. Reverse inscription: [VICT DD NN AVG ET CAES]. Diameter: 19.4mm, Weight: 2.29gms, die axis: 5
